name: Skeletal myogenesis and myoblast fusion
reason: All members concern skeletal muscle myoblast migration, fusion and fibre development.

name: Chemosensory perception and cranial sensory system development
reason: Taste and smell perception (receptors, Gbg-PLCb transduction) plus cranial nerve/ganglion, olfactory/GnRH placode and some retinal development; linked as special-sense organ development and innervation.

name: Cation-chloride cotransport and osmotic cell-volume regulation
reason: SLC12 cotransporters, NHEs, K/Na channels and their channelopathies with hypo/hyperosmotic responses and renal salt transport; pancreatic juice term is a minor outlier.

name: Viral infection: replication and host immune modulation
reason: HIV ENV/VPU processing, Dengue assembly and Dengue/SARS-CoV-2 immune modulation share only viral infection biology.

name: Common gamma-chain cytokine (IL-2/7/9) STAT5 signalling
reason: IL-2, IL-7 and IL-9 signalling via the common gamma chain and STAT5.

name: Dystroglycan matriglycan glycosylation (dystroglycanopathy)
reason: Two members are DAG1 matriglycan/LARGE dystroglycanopathy; 'localization of cell' and 'post-embryonic morphogenesis' are generic terms without that theme.

name: T cell tolerance and regulatory T cell control
reason: Peripheral tolerance, anergy, Treg differentiation and suppression of T cell activation/cytokines.

name: Vitamin C (ascorbate) metabolism and antioxidant vitamin response
reason: Ascorbate/dehydroascorbate metabolism and transport; vitamin E response and stellate activation are small related outliers.

name: Eye development, phototransduction and retinoid (vitamin A) metabolism
reason: Large vision cluster (retina, lens, photoreceptors, opsins, visual cycle) joined to retinoid/retinoic acid metabolism via the vitamin A visual cycle; ~10 misfits (luteolysis, oviduct, vagina, bile duct, BBB).

name: Myeloid, erythroid and megakaryocyte haematopoietic differentiation
reason: RUNX1 programmes, myeloid progenitors, erythroid and megakaryocyte/platelet differentiation BTMs; 'cell cycle and transcription' is minor.

name: Epidermal cell junctions and cornified skin barrier
reason: Desmosomes, hemidesmosomes, laminin/anchoring fibrils, keratinocyte cornification; cardiac terms tie in via desmosomal intercalated discs.

name: Xenobiotic and drug metabolism (phase I/II)
reason: CYP oxidation, acetylation, sulfonation and detoxification; steroid metabolism shares these enzymes.

name: Eicosanoid and PUFA-derived lipid mediator metabolism and signalling
reason: Prostaglandins, leukotrienes, lipoxins, resolvins, P450 HETE/EET and their receptors; vitamin K/E catabolism via CYP4F; few misfits (Th1 signature, GPCR/extracellular clusters, selenium).

name: Cholesterol efflux and reverse cholesterol transport (LXR)
reason: LXR-driven cholesterol efflux, HDL clearance, sterol homeostasis, foam-cell suppression.

name: Non-essential amino acid metabolism (glycine, proline, glyoxylate)
reason: Biosynthesis and catabolism of glycine, proline, glutamine- and aspartate-family amino acids.

name: Visual retinoid cycle in rods and cones
reason: All three are the visual cycle regenerating 11-cis-retinal, incl. RDH5 defect.

name: Vitamin K catabolism by CYP4F omega-hydroxylation
reason: Vitamin K/menaquinone catabolism; Reactome 'Fatty acids' is the CYP4 omega-hydroxylation set that also oxidises vitamin K side chains.

name: Interleukin-18 signalling
reason: IL-18 production and signalling; TNF signalling regulation is a minor related inflammatory term.

name: Monoamine/acetylcholine/purinergic GPCR control of cAMP and PLC
reason: Serotonin, muscarinic, adenosine/purinergic receptors coupling to adenylate cyclase inhibition/activation, PLC and cAMP breakdown.

name: Epithelial apical junctions and epithelial-mesenchymal transition
reason: Tight/adherens junction terms (incl. SARS PDZ targeting, claudin paracellular Mg transport) with EMT, which is defined by apical junction disassembly.

name: Heart morphogenesis: septation and second heart field
reason: Cardiac septum, ventricle, outflow/aorta and second heart field development.

name: Medium-chain fatty acid and peroxisomal metabolism
reason: Medium-chain fatty acid synthesis/catabolism; TYSND1 processes peroxisomal beta-oxidation enzymes.

name: Receptor endocytosis and lysosomal degradation
reason: Promotion of receptor internalisation, reduced recycling, lysosomal catabolism, clathrin cargo recognition.

name: Coronary and arterial vascular development
reason: Coronary vasculogenesis, cardiac VSMC differentiation, artery morphogenesis; endothelin blood pressure is a related vascular term.

name: Heparan sulfate biosynthesis (EXT1/EXT2 exostoses)
reason: HS-GAG chain synthesis by EXT1/2 and their exostosis defects.

name: G2/M transition and mitotic entry
reason: Cyclin A/B, PLK1, NEK activation and G2/M checkpoint.

name: Dolichol-linked N-glycosylation and congenital disorders of glycosylation
reason: Dolichol/GDP-mannose synthesis, ALG/DPM/MGAT steps and their CDG defects, N-glycan processing.

name: Host-pathogen interactions (bacterial toxins, Leishmania, SARS)
reason: Diphtheria/anthrax toxin uptake, CD163 and WNT5 Leishmania terms, SARS therapeutics and RHO-NADPH oxidase share only infection context.

name: Chromatin remodelling and histone deubiquitination
reason: Nucleosome organisation/CHD remodellers and repair-coupled chromatin remodelling plus UCH and JAMM metalloprotease DUBs (BAP1, BRCC36) acting on chromatin.

name: Chondrocyte differentiation and proliferation
reason: Cartilage condensation and chondrocyte differentiation/proliferation regulation.

name: Golgi organisation and COPI vesicle trafficking
reason: Golgi ribbon assembly/disassembly, COPI anterograde/retrograde traffic, Golgi retention.

name: Nucleotide, NAD(P) and phosphocreatine energy-carrier metabolism
reason: NAD salvage/nicotinate metabolism and nucleotide interconversion plus creatine/phosphocreatine and mitochondrial ATP/ADP transport; linked as cellular energy/redox cofactor homeostasis.

name: Cardiac muscle hypertrophic adaptation
reason: Cardiomyocyte growth, sarcomere organisation and cardiac muscle adaptation.

name: NADPH oxidase respiratory burst regulation
reason: Superoxide generation, respiratory burst and PMA (NOX activator) response in host defence.

name: LXR-IDOL lipoprotein receptor endocytosis and degradation
reason: LDLR/VLDLR internalisation and lysosomal degradation limiting cholesterol uptake, with general receptor internalisation terms.

name: Endosome-Golgi-lysosome vesicle trafficking and Rab regulation
reason: Clathrin coats, Rab GEFs/GAPs/prenylation, endosome-Golgi retrograde and Golgi-lysosome transport; few generic terms.

name: Adipogenesis and transcriptional control of lipid-glucose metabolism
reason: White/brown/beige adipocyte differentiation and lipolysis plus PPARG/SREBP/ChREBP/LXR, PKA/AMPK and glucagon nutrient-sensing control of metabolism.

name: Claudin-mediated paracellular magnesium transport
reason: Tight junction paracellular transport and magnesium homeostasis/transport (claudin-16/19 axis).

name: Intrinsic coagulation: factor VIII/IX defects (haemophilia)
reason: Intrinsic pathway and F8/F9 activation defects.

name: L1-family CAM-ankyrin sodium channel clustering
reason: L1, CHL1, NrCAM, neurofascin-ankyrin interactions clustering Nav channels.
